body.zh-Hant: 瑪麗-阿黛萊德1894年6月14日生於貝爾格城堡，是世襲大公威廉與布拉岡薩公主瑪麗亞·安娜所生六個女兒中的長女。她承襲母親的虔誠天主教信仰，這份宗教信念日後影響了她身為君主的決定。1907年大公國面臨繼承危機，威廉四世修訂1783年家族協定，確認她的繼承權，她因此成為世襲大公女。
body.en: Marie-Adélaïde was born on 14 June 1894 at Berg Castle, the eldest of the six daughters of Hereditary Grand Duke William and Princess Maria Anna of Braganza. She was raised in her mother's devout Catholic faith, a conviction that later influenced her decisions as sovereign. In 1907 the Grand Duchy faced a succession crisis, and William IV amended the 1783 Family Pact to confirm her right to succeed him, making her Hereditary Grand Duchess.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年大公去世，母親攝政六個月後，年僅十八歲的瑪麗-阿黛萊德即位，6月18日在政府與眾議院面前宣誓。登基之初，她對一項削弱教士影響師範教育的教育法遲遲未表態，經首相保羅·艾辛堅持，於8月10日簽署。1915年她拒絕批准兩處反教權市長的任命，引發內閣危機；其後由律師烏貝·盧奇組成清一色右派的政府，她行使憲法權力解散眾議院，重新舉行選舉。
body.en: After her father's death in 1912 and six months of regency by her mother, Marie-Adélaïde, then eighteen, took the throne and swore her oath before the government and the Chamber of Deputies on 18 June. Early in her reign she hesitated over an education law meant to reduce clerical influence over teacher training, and signed it on 10 August at Prime Minister Paul Eyschen's insistence. In 1915 she refused to approve the appointment of two anti-clerical mayors, which set off a ministerial crisis; a purely right-wing government was then formed under the lawyer Hubert Loutsch, and she used her constitutional right to dissolve the Chamber and call new elections.

heading.en: War, loss of support and abdication

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月德軍占領盧森堡，國家中立遭到侵犯。她接見德皇威廉二世的決定招致猛烈批評；此事雖主要由艾辛安排，仍強化了宮廷親德的印象。1916年她的政治處境已難以為繼，妹妹安東妮亞與巴伐利亞王儲魯普雷希特訂婚，更加深外界疑慮。1918年9月成立由埃米爾·勞特領導的聯合政府；與法國外長畢勝會面後才知盟國已不再信任她。她同意讓位給妹妹夏綠蒂，於1919年1月13日簽署退位文書，1月28日前往瑞士。
body.en: German troops occupied Luxembourg in August 1914, violating the country's neutrality. Her decision to receive Emperor Wilhelm II drew fierce criticism; although the initiative was mainly Eyschen's, it reinforced the image of a pro-German court. By 1916 her political position had become untenable, and the engagement of her sister Antonia to Crown Prince Rupprecht of Bavaria deepened suspicion. In September 1918 a unity government led by Émile Reuter was formed; a meeting with French Foreign Minister Stephen Pichon showed that the Allies no longer trusted her. She agreed to abdicate in favour of her sister Charlotte, signed the act of abdication on 13 January 1919 and left for Switzerland on 28 January.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年9月，瑪麗-阿黛萊德進入摩德納的加爾默羅修道院，但脆弱的健康使她無法發願；其後她轉往羅馬的貧窮小姊妹會，卻因副傷寒而放棄，回到巴伐利亞的霍恩堡療養，並入慕尼黑大學學醫。1923年11月病情復發，1924年1月24日去世，享年二十九歲。她的遺體起初葬在霍恩堡禮拜堂，1947年才遷入盧森堡聖母主教座堂的大公室地宮。
body.en: In September 1920 Marie-Adélaïde entered the Carmelite convent in Modena, but her fragile health prevented her from taking vows. She then turned to the Little Sisters of the Poor in Rome, gave that up after contracting paratyphoid fever, and went to Hohenburg in Bavaria to recover, where she enrolled at the University of Munich to study medicine. She relapsed in November 1923 and died on 24 January 1924, aged 29. Her body was first buried in the chapel of Hohenburg Castle and moved to the Grand Ducal Crypt of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Luxembourg only in 1947.

body.zh-Hant: 李可夫1881年2月25日生於薩拉托夫，出身農民家庭，在喀山大學研讀法律並參與學生運動。1899年他加入社會民主黨並投身地下革命活動，多次入獄與流放。1901年被捕，流放薩拉托夫；1902年被逐出俄國，在日內瓦與列寧結為朋友。1907年再度被捕，流放薩馬拉，但成功逃脫。
body.en: Rykov was born on 25 February 1881 in Saratov into a peasant family, studied law at Kazan University and took part in student unrest. In 1899 he joined the Social Democratic Party and worked in the revolutionary underground, and he was imprisoned and exiled several times. Arrested in 1901 he was exiled to Saratov; in 1902 he was expelled from Russia and became friends with Lenin in Geneva. Arrested again in 1907, he was exiled to Samara but escaped.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年李可夫參與革命；他曾是中央委員會成員，並曾任人民委員會副主席。1918年他任內務人民委員，1918至1921年與1923至1924年兩度出任最高國民經濟委員會主席。1919年他負責組織供應內戰中的陸軍與海軍；列寧生病期間由他代理，列寧去世後他主持人民委員會。
body.en: In 1917 Rykov took part in the revolution; he was a member of the Central Committee and served as deputy chairman of the Council of People's Commissars. In 1918 he was People's Commissar for Internal Affairs, and he chaired the Supreme Economic Council in 1918-1921 and again in 1923-1924. In 1919 he organised supplies for the army and fleet engaged in the civil war; he stood in for Lenin during Lenin's illness and, after Lenin's death, headed the Council of People's Commissars.

body.zh-Hant: 1924至1930年李可夫擔任蘇聯人民委員會主席。1920至1924年他是黨的組織局成員，1922至1930年是政治局成員。依1936年《義大利百科全書》的說法，他傾向溫和，是激進集體化最積極的反對者之一，但1929年表示服從，此後實際參與政治活動已微不足道。
body.en: From 1924 to 1930 Rykov was chairman of the Council of People's Commissars of the USSR. He was a member of the Organisation Bureau in 1920-1924 and of the Politburo in 1922-1930. According to the 1936 Enciclopedia Italiana he had moderate leanings and was one of the most energetic opponents of radical collectivisation, but he made his submission in 1929, after which his participation in active politics was insignificant.

heading.en: Origins and early Liberal Party career

body.zh-Hant: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·薩卡薩1874年12月21日出生於萊昂，是尼加拉瓜二十世紀初自由黨的重要成員。1926年他在卡洛斯·索羅薩諾的聯合政府中擔任副總統，隨後因保守黨人在埃米利亞諾·查莫洛領導下發動政變而被逐出。
body.en: Juan Bautista Sacasa was born in León on 21 December 1874 and rose in Nicaraguan politics as a leading member of the Liberal Party in the early twentieth century. In 1926 he served as vice president in Carlos Solórzano's coalition government, and was ousted after a coup by discontented Conservatives led by Emiliano Chamorro.

heading.zh-Hant: 自由黨反對派與美國干預

body.zh-Hant: 薩卡薩成為自由黨反對派領袖，並與何塞·馬里亞·蒙卡達將軍領導後續的自由黨起義。美國政府因他與自由黨的關係及墨西哥總統卡列斯的支持而反對他的總統主張，轉而把保守黨的阿道夫·迪亞斯安置在總統職位並以海軍陸戰隊支援。美國成功分化薩卡薩與蒙卡達的自由黨勢力後，監督了1928年選舉；蒙卡達當選總統，薩卡薩則出任尼加拉瓜駐華盛頓公使。
body.en: Sacasa became the leader of the Liberal opposition and, along with General José María Moncada, led subsequent Liberal uprisings. The US government opposed his claim to the presidency because of his Liberal ties and the support of Mexican president Plutarco Elías Calles, and instead placed the Conservative Adolfo Díaz in the presidency, backed by marines. After splitting the Liberal forces of Sacasa and Moncada, the United States supervised the 1928 elections; Moncada became president and Sacasa served as Nicaraguan minister to Washington.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期、與索莫查的權力鬥爭與流亡
heading.en: Presidency, power struggle with Somoza and exile

body.zh-Hant: 薩卡薩於1932年上台，當時桑地諾游擊隊正與美國海軍陸戰隊作戰；美軍同時建立尼加拉瓜國民警衛隊，並由安納斯塔西奧·索莫查·加西亞掌兵。他真誠嘗試與桑地諾談和，桑地諾卻遭國民警衛隊暗殺，使他陷入與姻侄索莫查的權力鬥爭。索莫查和國民警衛隊的勢力日增，削弱了總統的實權；1936年6月他被迫辭職，流亡美國，1946年4月17日死於洛杉磯。
body.en: Sacasa came to power in 1932, in the midst of Augusto César Sandino's guerrilla war against the US Marines; the United States meanwhile set up the Nicaraguan National Guard under Anastasio Somoza García. He tried in good faith to negotiate a peace accord with Sandino, but Sandino was assassinated by the National Guard, leaving Sacasa in a power struggle with Somoza, his nephew-in-law. Somoza's growing power and that of the National Guard decreased the president's de facto power; Somoza forced him to resign in June 1936, after which he went into exile in the United States, and he died in Los Angeles on 17 April 1946.
